prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: Create a cinematic close-up portrait of a young man with medium skin tone and dark hair, styled neatly. He is wearing a striking, bright orange collared shirt that stands out against the more subdued background. His expression is intense and focused, with slightly parted lips as if he is in the middle of speaking or reacting to something important. The lighting is soft but direct, illuminating his face evenly and highlighting the natural texture of his skin, while casting gentle shadows that add depth to his features. The background is blurred, featuring muted tones and indistinct shapes, suggesting a high-tech or futuristic setting without drawing attention away from the subject. The camera angle is at eye level, creating a sense of immediacy and engagement with the viewer. The overall color palette contrasts the vivid orange of the shirt with the neutral, cool tones of the background, enhancing the dramatic and immersive quality of the scene. The style is reminiscent of classic science fiction films, with a focus on character-driven storytelling and emotional intensity.
